slice: Native UIA reachability of the support preview, export entry point and bounded report/status text
revision_note: repair of the evidence at commit 1e204a5 after review (B-01, A-01, A-02 and three NITs); no product code and no plan text changed
dev_head_advanced_to: ae82b9d (HEAD moved while this slice ran; the measured binary was built from a clean `git archive` of abf2310 and the archived lib.rs blob hash matched abf2310)

binary.built: clean git archive of abf2310 -> CARGO_TARGET_DIR=C:\c\tmp\rel3-native-target cargo build --locked --release -p cos-desktop --bin cos-desktop (7m15s)

environment.input_path: UIA InvokePattern opened the diagnostics panel (no keyboard input needed). Keyboard rows used UIA SetFocus plus SendKeys only after the app's own window owned the foreground; the focused element was then read back and had to match the intended AutomationId before a loop started, and every key was preceded by a fresh GetForegroundWindow check against the measured PID's window (a mismatch aborts the loop instead of sending). The controlled session's log publishes FOCUS_READY_*|True and FOREGROUND_BEFORE_*|True; per-key aborts were 0. Earlier sessions were NOT verified this way and are not used for the keyboard rows; their log shows focus leaving the app for a foreign window after several steps.
environment.screenshots: not used; every row is an accessibility-tree observation

foreground_verification.per_key_rule: Send-Key re-checked GetForegroundWindow against the measured PID's window immediately before SendWait and after each key; 0 aborts in the published session.
foreground_verification.initial_state: FOREGROUND_IS_APP|False at the start of each session (before activation); the published verification lines are the ones taken after activation and before/within the keyboard rows.

native_lock.earlier_sessions: the success and cancel sessions predate the wrapper's owner logging; no lock-owner line exists for them and none is claimed. An earlier controlled attempt observed PRELAUNCH_COS_PROCESSES|1 (a pre-existing COS Desktop process) and was discarded rather than measured; window lookup was then scoped to the run's own PID and the published controlled session recorded PRELAUNCH_COS_PROCESSES|0.

commands: bash C:\tmp\rel3-native-work\session.sh   (lock acquire -> isolated LOCALAPPDATA launch with --fixture --fixture-file -> observe_a.ps1/observe_b.ps1 scoped to the launched PID -> lock release)

observed: lock acquired (owner=impl-rel1, pid of the launched app) and released
0 COS Desktop processes before launch, 1 after launch (the measured PID)
panel opened through UIA Invoke on diagnostics-toggle
preview generated by Enter on the verified-focused preview button

Tab forward and Shift+Tab backward with foreground verified before every key and app-only trails
graceful close (AFTER_CLOSE_RUNNING|False) and observation shutdown confirmed on stderr
runs.note: this session supplies the keyboard and report rows; it did not reach the save dialog.

observed: save dialog #32770 opened by Enter on the focused export button
successful save: status 保存しました, trace dialog=Selected;data=Ready;writer=Success;ui=StatusUpdated
saved file 573 bytes, no BOM, byte-identical to the preview text
runs.foreign_focus_exception: after several Tab steps the focused element left COS Desktop for a foreign window (ControlType.Document|RootWebArea; the title is redacted in the published log). This session is not used for the Tab/Shift+Tab rows.

observed: save dialog #32770 opened by Enter on the focused export button
Escape closed the dialog with no file written
runs.foreign_focus_exception: after several Tab steps the focused element left COS Desktop for a foreign window (ControlType.Document|RootWebArea and a ControlType.Group; titles redacted). This session is only used for the cancel row.

panel_open_control.detail: diagnostics-toggle, ControlType.Button, Name 診断情報を閉じる, IsKeyboardFocusable=True; UIA InvokePattern opened the panel and exposed support-preview-button.

preview_control.detail: support-preview-button, ControlType.Button, Name サポート情報を表示, IsKeyboardFocusable=True, enabled, on-screen; absent while the panel is closed, present after opening.

export_control.detail: support-export-button, ControlType.Button, Name サポート情報をエクスポート, IsKeyboardFocusable=True, enabled; rendered only after a preview exists (absent before preview, present after the preview Enter).

preview_text.detail: support-preview-readonly, ControlType.Text, IsKeyboardFocusable=False (read-only, not a Tab stop); Name is the rendered report.

status_text.detail: support-export-status appears after an export outcome; on success the element Name read 保存しました. No path or report text is part of the status.

tab_forward.detail: from a verified-focused diagnostics-toggle, Tab step 0 = support-preview-button, step 1 = support-export-button; all 24 recorded steps are COS Desktop controls and the log shows FOREGROUND_BEFORE_FORWARD|True with 0 aborts (tab-forward.txt). The success and cancel sessions are NOT used for this row: their logs show focus leaving the app for a foreign window.

tab_backward.detail: Shift+Tab from a verified-focused support-export-button: step 0 = support-preview-button, step 1 = diagnostics-toggle; all 24 recorded steps are COS Desktop controls (tab-backward.txt), FOREGROUND_BEFORE_BACKWARD|True, 0 aborts.

status_is_not_a_tab_stop.detail: in the controlled session's 24 forward Tab steps and 24 backward steps no support-export-status element appeared (TAB_FWD_HAS_STATUS=False); it is a Role::Label with IsKeyboardFocusable=False. This absence is scoped to that session.

save_dialog_entry_point.detail: Enter on the focused support-export-button opened the native dialog #32770 named 名前を付けて保存.

cancel_path.detail: Escape closed the #32770 dialog; the target file did not exist afterwards; the trace recorded dialog=Cancelled;data=Rejected;writer=NotStarted;ui=StatusPreserved.

success_save.detail: saved 573 bytes with no BOM, SHA-256 equal to the preview text, status 保存しました, trace dialog=Selected;data=Ready;writer=Success;ui=StatusUpdated.

report_bounds.detail: 573 UTF-8 bytes, 19 lines, no BOM; within the recorded 12,288-byte / 24-line ceiling. The report states Source: fixture and Runtime version unknown.

already_exists_native_wording.detail: no overwrite-path attempt was made in this slice.

screen_reader_quality.detail: UIA tree only; no screen-reader output was captured.

runtime_provider_logs.detail: the fixture report contains no Runtime/Provider logs; Runtime version is unknown because observation does not expose it.

export_policy.detail: format, destination, retention and consent are not decided or changed by this slice.

foreign_focus_exception.detail: in both sessions the Tab traversal left COS Desktop after a few steps and the focused element was reported outside the app (ControlType.Document|RootWebArea, plus a ControlType.Group). The fact is preserved; the foreign application titles are replaced by <foreign-window-title-redacted>.

redaction.rule: only the name field after the last control-type field is replaced; control types and the fact of foreign focus are preserved. No COS Desktop name, report text or identifier was redacted.
redaction.verified: a grep for the removed titles returns no match in the published artifacts.

save dialog and success/cancel inside the controlled session (the controlled session observed focus/report rows only; dialog rows come from the two earlier sessions)
limits: UIA reachability is not product acceptance and does not decide DD-22 export policy.
The fixture report is Desktop-local; it contains no Runtime/Provider logs and is not evidence that such logs exist.

Foreground ownership on this desktop is not stable: the two earlier sessions lost focus to a foreign window, so the keyboard rows are scoped to the controlled session that verified foreground before every key.
Lock-owner evidence is published only for the controlled session; the earlier sessions predate the wrapper's owner logging and no lock claim is made for them.
The private PowerShell probe scripts and the isolated build tree are not committed; the evidence records their observations and the binary/source hashes instead.
